FN-U9RIRDD-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 28
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/09/2026
House Bill 28 as introduced would decrease income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by
an estimated maximum of $52,000 annually beginning in Fiscal Year 2027 through Fiscal Year
2031 by establishing a refundable, non-transferable income tax credit for the recycling of oyster
shell material. The credit would have an annual cap of $100,000 with a maximum credit of
$2,000 per claimant and would sunset after tax year 2030.
